title: China Moves to Lock Down the Wafer Supply Chain Powering Its AI Chip Push
teaser: China aims for 80% chip self-sufficiency by 2030, fueling a wave of domestic competition targeting global chip giants.
summary: China is aggressively pursuing semiconductor self-sufficiency, aiming to source over 70% of its silicon wafers domestically this year, marking a significant pivot in global tech supply chains. This drive is fueled by US export controls and aims for 80% self-sufficiency by 2030. Global raw wafer capacity share estimates suggest China's market share could jump from 3% (2020) to 32% (2026). title: AI's big messaging pivot
teaser: Sam Altman shifts AI narrative: Instead of job loss, he says AI will create entirely new tasks for humans.
summary: Sam Altman, CEO of OpenAI, has pivoted his public stance from acknowledging AI's potential to make labor's price approach zero to asserting that AI will create new human roles, framing the shift as evolution, not revolution. Previously, Altman warned of an "idle class" in 2014 and noted labor price declines in 2021. This shift comes as public sentiment sours; polls show the American public is strongly turning against AI.
